comment_regular: Verified active-effect manager: obtains the target's active-effect list, checks target parent/node/cell/process conditions, then enters the list loop. Each eligible ActiveEffect goes through ActiveEffect_Base_ProcessEffect; removed effects are unlinked and destroyed by their virtual destructor. Actor_ProcessMagicEffect calls this manager each actor process tick.
